claim: External MS biomarker reviews describe MS as heterogeneous and caution that a single marker may be insufficient for a complex disease.
future_grounding_route: Use only as broad external context; any invariant or biomarker claim must be grounded through the project's held-data null and validation framework.
project_use: External heterogeneity context for V49 review of the project's no-load-bearing-invariant result; not evidence for or against a specific invariant.

source.citation: Housley et al. Biomarkers in Multiple Sclerosis. Cold Spring Harbor Perspectives in Medicine. 2019.
source.label: Cold Spring Harbor Perspectives MS biomarker review

why_unverifiable: The project cannot rerun an external biomarker review or its literature synthesis from held data.
